meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成支持备注和跳转的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常要把资料整理成可演示的幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn your content into a presentation deck with speaker notes and branching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn rough notes into a navigable slide deck for presenting.

howto.what: 它会把你的演讲或介绍做成一套可翻页的幻灯片,支持分步出现、按钮跳转和演讲备注;在浏览器里放映,不是视频。也能把网页转成同样形式。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片、演示文稿或推销套牌,或要把网页转成幻灯片时触发;若只是说“做个演示”等模糊请求,它会先确认是否做 HyperFrames 幻灯片。

say.text: 帮我做一个介绍新产品的幻灯片,每页带演讲者备注。
say.note: 会生成一套可翻页带备注的演示套牌。

say.text: 把公司官网首页转成一套幻灯片。
say.note: 会保留原网页的视觉与交互,转成逐页演示。

say.text: 做一个带分支跳转的幻灯片:讲完主线后可点进“成本分析”页。
say.note: 会设置热点,点击可跳到分支页。

howto.what_en: It turns your talk into a clickable deck: discrete slides, step reveals, hotspot navigation, speaker notes. Output is a browser-runnable deck, not a video. It can also convert an existing page into such a deck.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation, or pitch deck, or want to turn a page into a deck. For vague requests like 'make a demo', it first confirms whether to build a HyperFrames slideshow.

say_en.text: Create a slide deck introducing our new product, with speaker notes.
say_en.note: Generates a navigable slide deck with notes.

say_en.text: Turn our company homepage into a slide deck.
say_en.note: Preserves the original page's visuals and interactions.

say_en.text: Make a deck with branching: after the main line, 'Cost Analysis' opens details.
say_en.note: Sets a hotspot so clicking jumps to the branch slide.
